Name: Archaeology Skill for Stardew 1.5
Author: MoonSlime
Description:
[size=3]Go level up a new skill as you dig up Artifact spots! 
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Gain EXP from Artifact spots, clay spots, digging something up in the mines, or from panning[/size]
[*][size=3]As you level up, gain access to (currently) two displays. You can put artifacts on these displays through the Preservation Chamber machine (learned at level 2). Artifacts on display sell for a lot more than those that aren't![/size]
[*][size=3]At level 8 you unlock the grinding. Similar to the bonemill, you can turn rusty metal artifacts into ore. Or pure gold ones into ore. There are a few things you can shove into the grinder, so experiment![/size]
[*][size=3]Choose professions that increase gold gained from selling artifacts, speed boost when digging up artifacts, or even be able to pan for artifacts![/size]
[/list][size=3]

Here are the 6 new professions
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]level 5a, Pioneer: More artifact spots have a chance to spawn each day.[/size]
[*][size=3]------- Level 10a1, Antiquarian: When you dig up an artifact spot, get a bonus, guaranteed artifact[/size]
[*][size=3]------- Level 10a2, Curator: When you sell an artifact that is on display, it is worth more.[/size]
[*][size=3]Level 5b, Trowler: Have a chance to get artifacts from panning[/size]
[*][size=3]------- Level 10b1, Dowser: The loot table for panned items is expanded[/size]
[*][size=3]------- Level 10b2, Gold Rusher: When you get an item from panning or from Digging an artifact spot, you get a minute speed boost[/size]
[/list][size=3]

Configs
[list]
[*]Alternative skill page icon: Changes the skill page icon from a shovel to a brush on a rock. Requires a restart to reload the skill
[*]Enable Prestige: Requires MARGO: Allows Archaeology to prestige like other skills. Requires a restart to reload the skill after changing the config.
[/list]
Compatibility
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14470]MARGO[/url]: Make sure to Click the *enable prestige* config
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/174]All Professions[/url]: All spacecore skills are already compatible with all professions.﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]: The Water shifter is [b][i][u]NOT COMPATIBLE[/u][/i][/b] with automate and automate won't see it. I have no plans to add automate functionality to it. However, if someone wants to code it themselves, my DMs are open.
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿: The mod is [u]not 100% compatible[/u] with CJB Item spawner. Most items will show up in it just fine. However the Water Shifter, Glass Path, and Bone Path that show up are the Dummy Objects I used to make their crafting recipes and have no functionality.
[*]Better Panning: Works with better panning
[*]Upgradable Pan: Works with upgradable pan
[/list]
[/size] [i][size=5][size=4]How To Install[/size]
[/size][/i][size=3]Install required mods[i].
[/i]Download, unzip, and place the ExcavationSkill folder into the Stardew Valley Mod folder.
If installed on an existing file, the new professions should be immediately available.[/size]
Should be compatible with most other mods.  Please share incompatible mods on Nexus.
Not compatible with Android.

[size=3]Special thanks to: The stardew valley discord, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34250790]spacechase0[/url] for the magic mod, which I used to help set up this one greatly, DrBird for the same reason
